So we need to use cp with source FinalReport.txt and destination Archives/ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt? But the cp tool says both source and destination must be local to the current directory. No file paths allowed. That means we can't specify a path in destination. But we can copy into a directory if destination is a directory; but then the source will be copied into that directory. But we want rename. According to cp description: "If the destination is a directory, the source file or directory will be copied into the destination directory." So we could do cp with source FinalReport.txt and destination Archives. That would copy into Archives preserving original name. But we want rename. There's no direct rename via cp. But rename requires local names. We can cd into Archives, then mv FinalReport.txt ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt. That works. So steps: cp FinalReport.txt Archives, then cd Archives, then mv FinalReport.txt ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt, then cd .. back to Documentation. Let's do that.
